PAPER 1 — THEORY
Paradigms: dichotomy (Wilson) → NPA (Minnowbrook) → NPM → NPS
Thinkers: Taylor · Fayol · Weber · Simon · Barnard · Waldo
Merton (goal displacement) · McGregor/Maslow/Herzberg
Riggs (prismatic-sala) · Ostrom (public choice)
Structures: line-staff · leadership · accountability web
Personnel · budgets (PPBS/ZBB) · admin law · comparative
OTs & policy: implementation gap (Pressman-Wildavsky)
style: thinker → context → claim → Indian echo → critique
PAPER 2 — INDIAN ADMINISTRATION
Foundations: Mauryan-Mughal → colonial → constitutional (312)
Union: Cabinet Secretariat · NITI vs Commission · DOPT
State: CM secretariat · chief secretary · field: DM debate
Local: PESA · 74th devolution index · e-gov stack (DBT/PFMS)
Reforms: 1st/2nd ARC · Prakash Singh police line · appraisal
Welfare: NFSA-PDS · health/education missions · Poshan
DM Act 2005 architecture · CPGRAMS · social audit · Lokpal/CVC
style: constitutional hook → institutional map → record → ARC-referenced reform
TWELVE-WEEK FIRST PASS + THE LEDGERS
wk 1-2 paradigms · wk 3-5 thinkers (3-4/wk, application cards) · wk 6 machinery · wk 7 comparative+OTs · wk 8-10 India machinery+reforms · wk 11 welfare cases · wk 12 PYQ map
